Key findings: Reims has a compact but genuine tech calendar. The strongest hook for a visitor is **June 23-25** — CoTer Numérique (public-sector IT congress, 1 300+ attendees) runs June 23-24 at the Centre de Congrès, immediately followed by the free Fête de l'Innovation (startup pitches + networking) on June 25 evening at Villa Douce. For cybersecurity, HS'R CTF is June 5-6 at URCA. Recurring developer meetups exist via Sacrée Tech but run irregularly. TERRITORIALIS (Oct 1-2) adds a second window with a digital-transformation dimension.
